senses.gloss: रिश् r. 6th cl. (रिशति) To hurt, to injure, to kill or attempt to kill.

रिष् r. 1st cl. (रेषति) r. 4th cl. (रिष्यति) To hurt, to kill, or attempt to
kill. r. 6th cl. (रिष्णाति) To separate, to depart.

रिश्य m. (-श्यः) A deer.
 E. रिश् to hurt, aff. क्यप्; also रिष्य ।

रिष्य m. (-ष्यः) A deer.
 E. रिष् to hurt, to be hurt, aff. क्यप् ।

रिषि m. (-षिः) A saint.
 E. रि substituted for ऋ; see ऋषि ।

रिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
 1. Hurt, injured.
 2. Unlucky.
 3. Lucky.
 n. (-ष्टं)
1. Happiness, prosperity.
 2. Good-luck, fortune.
 3. Bad-luck, ill-
fortune.
 4. Destruction, loss, privation.
 5. Mischief, harm.
 6. Sin.
m. (-ष्टः)
 1. A sword.
 2. The soap-nut-tree.
 3. A demon, destroyed by
VIṢṆU.
 E. रिष् to hurt or injure, aff. क्त ।

रिष्टक m. (-कः) The soap-berry plant, (Sapindus of several species.) E.
रिष्ट the same, कन् added.

रिष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) A sword.
 f. (-ष्टिः) Prosperity, good fortune.
 E. रिष् to hurt, aff. क्तिन् ।

रिष्व mfn. (-ष्वः-ष्वा-ष्वं) Mischievous, injurious.
 E. रिष् to hurt, Unādi aff.
वन्, form irr.
